links.outcome: Calibration (O:E ratio) of CVD risk models in Chinese cohort before and after recalibration
links.effect: Models underpredicted risk in CHERRY by 60%; population-based recalibration gave O:E ratios of 1.080, 1.115, 1.153 for DeepSurv, age-specific DeepSurv, DeepHit; individual-based recalibration gave 1.040 and 1.054.
links.quote: The population-based recalibration method largely corrected the initial risk underestimation, yielding observed-to-expected (O:E) ratios of 1.080, 1.115, and 1.153 for recalibrated DeepSurv, age-specific DeepSurv, and DeepHit, achieving comparable calibration to individual-based recalibration method (O:E ratios: 1.040, 1.054 for DeepSurv and age-specific DeepSurv).
